title: Covenant
problem: Covenant (perk 289) is never read: after all five Runes every Rune cast runs on-attack twice, for any caster
notes: Hook spec: research/handoff_eval.md Hook batch R (loader/hooks_R.c, research/hooks_R.json). In-game test: without Covenant, cast all five Rune spells then a sixth Rune: on-attack effects run once; with Covenant they run twice.

release_notes.intended: Once your creatures have cast each Rune spell this battle, their on-attack effects activate 1 additional time.
release_notes.actual: The game gave this to any caster, with or without the perk.
release_notes.fix: Now only Covenant owners get it.
